title.narrative: Danish Consortium Project on Survivor Recovery, Human Rights and Independent Media in Post-July Uprising Bangladesh

description.narrative:
The development objective of the development cooperation among the parties is ‘Promoting an inclusive, resilience-promoOng transition to democracy and human rights in Bangladesh’.
Key results: • By 2028, civil society organisations have enhanced capacity to deliver and promote access to trauma-informed, survivor-centred rehabilitation and other forms of redress for survivors of torture and related violations perpetrated in context of the July 2024 Uprising in Bangladesh • Human rights actors (including the NHRC and CSOs) undertake strong advocacy for a revision of the NHRC legal framework, to enable an NHRI with a strong mandate and alignment with the Paris Principles, and human rights actors articulate demands for human rights accountability and promote a sustained vision for human rights-based reform. • A pluralistic, inclusive and resilient media environment in Bangladesh, strengthened through reform processes, safety mechanisms, and strategic support to an emerging independent media sector

title.narrative: DIHR Outcome: The National Human Rights Commission of Bangladesh (NHRC) has capacity to carry out its mandate and role in monitoring, protecting and promoting human rights in Bangladesh, and supports the reform process towards a democratic transition based on human rights; and civil society actors articulate demands for human rights accountability and promote a sustained societal culture of human rights

The NHRC delivers human rights monitoring and public statements of a high quality, reflecting independence and integrity of the institution. Civil society and youth are visible with human rights demands in public dialogue and political processes and seek cooperation with the NHRC and trust its integrity and professionalism.

target.value: The NHRC delivers on its mandate areas with independence and integrity, and civil society and youth play a visible and strategic role in promoting human rights-based democracy and rule of law.
